A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed models can be used to estimate the human motion with a similar accuracy to the one achieved with a Vicon based system.
, in the case of the upper limb, IMUs can be used to reconstruct human motion with a good accuracy, but the accuracy depends on the model and the algorithm used for the estimation.

IMU motion tracking can be considered a reliable and accurate method to track upper limb motion, with the exception of the elbow joint, for which the estimation error is higher than for the other two joints.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the choice of a model to be adopted in a specific application is strongly related to the specific requirements and constraints of the application.

, for the considered scenario, the IMU motion tracking system can be considered a reliable alternative to the Vicon system, at a lower cost and with the advantage of being self contained and wearable.
IMU based human motion tracking is a viable solution for many human motion assessment and human robot applications.
